name: Feedback state
import: import { FeedbackState, FeedbackStateIcon, FeedbackStateContent, FeedbackStateTitle, FeedbackStateDescription, FeedbackStateActions } from "@/components/ui/feedback-state"
description: A status-driven block for the state of a region — loading, error, success, info/pending — as a page, panel, or compact inline row.

status.description: Tints the icon and sets the ARIA role (error → alert, else status).

layout.description: page = fills the whole region, panel = a card-sized block, inline = a compact status row.

forbidden: Do not use FeedbackState for a message beside existing content; that's Alert.
Do not use it as a rich first-run onboarding screen; that's Empty state.
Do not add a prominent border — the soft fill is the container.
Do not signal status with color alone; keep the icon and text meaningful.
example:
<FeedbackState status="error" layout="panel">
  <FeedbackStateIcon><CircleAlert /></FeedbackStateIcon>
  <FeedbackStateContent>
    <FeedbackStateTitle>Couldn't load the page</FeedbackStateTitle>
    <FeedbackStateDescription>Check your connection and try again.</FeedbackStateDescription>
  </FeedbackStateContent>
  <FeedbackStateActions>
    <Button>Retry</Button>
  </FeedbackStateActions>
</FeedbackState>

responsive.note: Interactive targets should remain at least 44px. Layouts should fit parent width without horizontal overflow on mobile.
